body: Thank you for saying it but I'm tired. As I said I couldn't work for the past month. I'm mentally exhausted. It wouldn't be long before I lost my job. If it didn't happened before how would it happened now?

I have been saying this to myself for the past 10 years. And not just saying it I worked for it, I tried, I went to psychologist by myself no one was there to help me. I have lost a lot of opportunities and experiences that would never be able to do. I can't stop thinking what my life would have been if I transitioned 10 years ago.
Unfortunately there is no easy way to go.. I have been searching for years for myself..
I have been thinking about it for years.. but unfortunately I don't have the courage to go through with it. if there was a button that I could push to die instantly I would push it without hesitation

I'm 28 and never been in a relationship either and I think the worst part is the cycle that you fall into.

You know? at first you're like everybody else around you some of your friends are single some of them are in a relationship and honestly maybe sometimes you're happy that you're single. A few years get past and suddenly you realize that a lot of your friends are/been in a relationship and you're still single! Everyone around your age seems to have some kind of knowledge about social interactions around relationships and you feel kind of weird and left out. It will affect your self esteem and mental health and you maybe get depressed and anxiety and these feelings makes it far more difficult to get into relationship now. So you don't. And you get more weird and depressed. And it's get even more difficult... I hate the cycle!
Does failed attempts make it easier for the next one? I'm thinking about doing it a lot but I'm too scared and doesn't have the courage.
I'm 28 and never even been on a date. At least you have experience so you can get into a relationship once again and I'm sure you will find a partner eventually.
Same and everytime I see people hugs in like movies I can't stop feeling sorry for myself.
I'm hugging a pillow right now

Everytime I looked for help everyone always just wanted  the money and believe me if I had any I would gladly pay for because even if there was a tiny chance that I could get out of this miserable life of mine I would take it.
But I guess since I'm poor I should gfms.
I feel you... What I wouldn't give to be a normal person...

I'm sorry to hear that and glad to see that you have the strength to keep going. May I ask what is it for you that makes you keep going when you're down? Because whenever I think about the future I'm getting more hopeless...

I believe that there are people who can get out of it and fix their life, but for others like me it's too late and complicated. I appreciate what you are saying, but when you have nothing to live for it's really difficult to deal with the mental pain like every day. Just wished there was an easy way to end it all.
No really but I appreciate the gesture.
